headlines.description: The Ravens got a pair of touchdown passes from Joe Flacco and rolled past the rival Pittsburgh Steelers 26-6 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco throws 2 TDs as Ravens roll Steelers

headlines.description: C.J. Spiller scored on a 102-yard kickoff return, and rookie receiver Sammy Watkins had a 12-yard touchdown catch in leading the Buffalo Bills to a 29-10 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills, Spiller sink Dolphins on emotional day

headlines.description: Running back Giovani Bernard picked up a Bengals offense missing receiver A.J. Green on Sunday, turning short passes into big plays, and Cincinnati's defense held down yet another top quarterback for a 24-10 victory over the Atlanta Falcons.

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: Billy Cundiff kicked a 29-yard field goal with three seconds left, giving the Cleveland Browns a 26-24 win over the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns drop Saints to 0-2 with stunning upset

headlines.description: DeMarco Murray ran for 169 yards and a touchdown, Dan Bailey kicked four field goals, and the Dallas Cowboys routed the Tennessee Titans 26-10 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys bounce back, cruise past Titans

events.name: New England Patriots at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Tom Brady and the New England Patriots took advantage of Adrian Peterson's absence and Matt Cassel's four interceptions, and Chandler Jones returned a field goal he blocked for a touchdown right before halftime to lead a 30-7 victory over the Vikings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, Patriots bounce back to rout Vikings

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at New York Giants

headlines.description: Ted Ginn Jr. ran 71 yards on a punt return for a go-ahead fourth-quarter touchdown and the Arizona Cardinals beat the error-prone New York Giants 25-14 Sunday despite playing without injured starting quarterback Carson Palmer.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards win without Palmer, top TO-prone Giants

headlines.description: RG3, D-Jax hurt as Redskins top Jaguars 41-10
headlines.shortLinkText: RG3, D-Jax hurt as Redskins top Jaguars 41-10

headlines.description: Cam Newton made a successful return to the field, throwing for 281 yards and a touchdown in the Carolina Panthers' 24-7 victory over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers knock off Lions in Newton's return

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Antonio Gates had three touchdown catches and the San Diego Chargers controlled the tempo to keep Seattle's offense off the field and upset the defending Super Bowl champion Seahawks 30-21 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers stun Hawks behind Gates' 3 TDs

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Zuerlein's 4 FGs lifts Rams over Buccaneers
headlines.shortLinkText: Zuerlein's 4 FGs lifts Rams over Buccaneers

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Terrance Knighton batted away Alex Smith's fourth-and-goal pass to Dwayne Bowe with 15 seconds left, preserving the Broncos' 24-17 win over the scrappy Chiefs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos thwart Chiefs with goal-line stand

events.name: New York Jets at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for three touchdowns, Jordy Nelson had a career-high 209 yards receiving and the Green Bay Packers rallied from an 18-point deficit for a 31-24 win over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers rally from 18-point deficit to top Jets

headlines.description: Watt's TD catch fuels Texans' 30-14 win vs Raiders
headlines.shortLinkText: Watt's TD catch fuels Texans' 30-14 win vs Raiders

headlines.description: Jay Cutler passed for three fourth-quarter touchdowns after much of Chicago's starting defense went down, and the Bears beat the San Francisco 49ers 28-20 Sunday night to spoil their Levi's Stadium debut.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutler, Bears stun 49ers with 21 in 4th quarter

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw a tying touchdown pass with 3:25 to go, and then set up Cody Parkey for the winning 36-yard field goal as time expired, lifting Philadelphia to a 30-27 win at Indianapolis on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foles steady in clutch to rally Eagles past Colts
